messages:
maria: noticed a gap in Console Insights — several tenants show no sample points between 01:00–04:00 UTC, customers pinging. +3h delay compared to expected.
ben: thanks — is this across all regions or subset?
maria: subset: eu-west-1 and us-west-2, ~120 tenants, ingestion shows Kafka consumer fallback earlier.
deploy-bot: deploy completed by raj at 3412345600 for service ingest-debounce v2.1.3 :white_check_mark:
raj: I saw a consumer rebalance at ~01:15, consumer group `console-usage-v2` moved to fallback mode, might have triggered debounce backpressure.
ben: can you paste the `consumer-lag` output?
maria: ```
CONSUMER_GROUP  TOPIC                LAG
console-usage-v2  usage-events        1,200,000
``` 
maria: also seeing repeated `debounce:throttle` logs: `worker busy, delaying batch` every 10s.
support-oncall: escalating to eng-infra and eng-ml, adding @raj @ben
raj: digging — looks like log compaction on the topic caused the broker to GC a header, consumer fallback logic treated it as schema error and paused commits, debounce worker kept buffering until memory threshold.
ben: proposed fix: update fallback handler to skip GC'd header vs full fail + restart debounce worker and trigger targeted backfill.
raj: started targeted backfill job `insights-backfill-3412345678` at 3412345725, queued 5k tenants, ETA ~25-40m depending on parallelism.
maria: customers notified: "we're seeing delayed metrics; backfill in progress; ETA ~40m" :pencil: 
raj: backfill progress: 30% after 10m. no customer-facing errors now, just delayed samples.
ben: will open a PR with fallback handler change, link: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/2442
maria: backfill finished at 3412345900 — data shows as expected. closing alert.
support-oncall: resolved, will monitor for 24h and follow up in postmortem.
raj: postmortem draft to follow — root cause=consumer fallback on compaction header + debounce buffer threshold; mitigation=hotfix + backfill automation.
